Name: Cursor AI
Segment: Active, daily practitioner of AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code) — able to define team-wide workflows around them

Name: Workers AI
Segment: Almost all products in Cloudflare’s portfolio are or will be powered by Argo technology, including CDN, Spectrum, Magic Transit, Stream, Workers, Workers AI, R2, WARP, and more. As a member of the Argo team, you’ll be a key technical contributor to the cutting edge network software infrastructure used by those products.

Name: AWS Athena
Segment: Hands-on experience with SIEM or log analytics platforms and data lake technologies (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Clickhouse, Sentinel, Splunk, Datadog, AWS Athena, Azure synapse, Databricks or equivalent) and alerting/monitoring tooling.

Name: WLM
Segment: System Performance – responsible for measuring system capacity demand, managing WLM settings, providing source data for SCRT reports, maintaining the z/OS Performance Alert Monitor, analyzing system resource consumption on demand, performing DB2 buffer pool analysis regularly, and supporting the IPM process.

Name: z/OS
Segment: System Performance – responsible for measuring system capacity demand, managing WLM settings, providing source data for SCRT reports, maintaining the z/OS Performance Alert Monitor, analyzing system resource consumption on demand, performing DB2 buffer pool analysis regularly, and supporting the IPM process.

Name: GCP Organization Policy
Segment: Hands-on experience implementing preventative guardrails in at least one hyperscaler (GCP Organization Policy, AWS SCPs or Config, Azure Policy). You should be able to walk us through a policy you rolled out, what it broke, and how you handled the fallout.

Name: Organization Policy
Segment: Hands-on experience implementing preventative guardrails in at least one hyperscaler (GCP Organization Policy, AWS SCPs or Config, Azure Policy). You should be able to walk us through a policy you rolled out, what it broke, and how you handled the fallout.

Name: LaunchDarkly
Segment: LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control.

Name: Swift
Segment: Solid software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building, shipping, or maintaining production native mobile applications (iOS with Swift/Objective-C or Android with Kotlin/Java).

Name: EDS
Segment: Perform advanced physical failure analysis using SEM, FIB, EDS, SAM, cross-sectioning, and related techniques to identify failure mechanisms in silicon, packaging, and interconnects

Name: FIB
Segment: Perform advanced physical failure analysis using SEM, FIB, EDS, SAM, cross-sectioning, and related techniques to identify failure mechanisms in silicon, packaging, and interconnects

Name: Cortex
Segment: The BT team partners with the AI & Data Technology teams to optimize solutions & deployment processes on platforms including Snowflake (Cortex, Streamlit), N8N, Airtable, Salesforce, DataHub, Claude/CoWork, and Stonly.

Name: The PlanetScale
Segment: The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads.

Name: Use SQL
Segment: Use SQL and other tools to collect, process, and analyze large datasets from claims, EHR, HIE, and other programmatic and operational sources

Name: RS-422
Segment: Working knowledge and hands-on experience with serial communication protocols, including RS-422, RS-485, and CAN, for integration and troubleshooting of test systems.

Name: RS-485
Segment: Working knowledge and hands-on experience with serial communication protocols, including RS-422, RS-485, and CAN, for integration and troubleshooting of test systems.

Name: Helm Charts
Segment: You're comfortable in the DevOps warzone: CI/CD, Linux, GitHub, Helm Charts, Terraform, Open source and all the good stuff.

Name: Solid
Segment: Solid Python and/or TypeScript/React fundamentals — you write clean code and can reason about what a framework is doing underneath it

Name: TPUs
Segment: The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of modern deep learning systems, combined with strong engineering expertise across JAX and TPUs, layer-level optimization, large-scale distributed training, streaming, low-latency and asynchronous inference, inference compilers, and advanced parallelization techniques.

Name: HPLC
Segment: Experience analyzing and purifying DNA-conjugates using common analytical tools (LCMS/HPLC).
